name: NuScale Power Corp
collection_note: WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted at the first call; the entire pack was built from directly-addressed authoritative URLs (SEC EDGAR submissions API, SEC XBRL companyconcept API, the as-filed 10-Q / DEF 14A / 8-K / SCHEDULE 13G documents, the company's own newsroom, and two independent quote aggregators). No value below is from model memory.

legal_name.note: EDGAR conformed name is 'NUSCALE POWER Corp'. A Delaware corporation; principal offices 1100 NE Circle Blvd., Suite 350, Corvallis, OR 97330.

former_names.note: Same CIK. SPAC that took NuScale public; its IPO closed 2020-11-27 (10-Q glossary). Renamed on the 2022 business combination.

second_legal_entity_same_name.note: Subsidiary of NuScale Power Corporation. The filings call them 'NuScale Corp' and 'NuScale LLC'. Financial results differ materially between the two levels (see traps).

isin.note: DERIVED, not directly sourced. CUSIP 67079K100 is stated verbatim in two independent SCHEDULE 13G filings (Van Eck 2026-08-14, BlackRock 2026-07-29). ISIN = 'US' + CUSIP + Luhn check digit 7, computed here. Flagged as derived so the differ does not treat a mismatch as an app bug without re-checking.

bse_code.note: NOT LISTED IN INDIA. BSE scrip 544774 'SMR Jewels Ltd' is an unrelated Indian SME company that merely shares the letters SMR. Any BSE code attached to NuScale in the app is a collision bug, not a data point.

face_value.unit: USD par value per share (both Class A and Class B)
face_value.note: US nominal par value. It is NOT the Indian 'face value' concept and carries no valuation meaning: at 410.4M Class A shares the entire par-value line on the balance sheet is $41 thousand. Any per-share ratio computed against face value here is nonsense.

last_declared_per_share.note: None. The company has never declared or paid a dividend on Class A common stock; 'Dividend: n/a' on the quote page and no dividend line appears in the 10-Q financing cash flows.

week52.note: The $8.27 close is 85.6% below the 52-week high and 14.7% above the 52-week low. NO SPLIT, BONUS OR REVERSE SPLIT occurred in the window - the range is a genuine bubble-and-collapse, corroborated by year-end market caps of $1.97B (2024) -> $4.20B (2025) -> $3.39B (2026 to date): https://companiesmarketcap.com/nuscale-power/marketcap/ . An app that 'corrects' this range as a corporate-action artefact would be wrong.

shareholding.note: US equivalent of the Indian shareholding-pattern block. There is NO SEBI-style quarterly promoter/FII/DII/public/pledge filing for a US issuer. The closest filed equivalents are the annual proxy beneficial-ownership table (>5% holders and insiders, one date per year) and SCHEDULE 13G/13D filings (event-driven). promoter_pct, fii_pct, dii_pct and pledged_pct_of_promoter DO NOT EXIST for this issuer - see world_gaps.

proxy_basis.value: 323,734,120 Class A + 19,375,371 Class B issued and outstanding as of 2026-03-30
proxy_basis.note: Class A count has since risen to 410.4M via the ATM, so every percentage in this table is already stale by design.

greater_than_five_percent_holders.note: Wholly owned by Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR). Also the counterparty on the RoPower FEED Phase 2 engineering contract - a RELATED PARTY that is simultaneously the largest holder and a revenue source.
Holds 99.3% of Class B, i.e. essentially the entire remaining noncontrolling interest. Owns ZERO Class A - invisible to any screen that looks only at the listed class.

aggregator_insider_ownership_pct.note: CONFLICT WITH THE FILED PROXY (1.28% as of 2026-03-30). Both are 'right': the proxy includes options/RSUs exercisable within 60 days over a smaller share base; the aggregator does not, over a 27% larger base. Recorded, not reconciled.

latest_13g_filings.note: 19,974,830 of those shares are economically the VanEck Uranium and Nuclear ETF's - i.e. most of the largest reported 'institutional holder' is passive thematic-ETF flow, not a fundamental holder.

short_interest.note: 15.1% short interest. There is no Indian analogue to this field and no SEBI-style pledge disclosure exists.

noncontrolling_interest_ownership_split_.note: The economic split flipped from 47/53 to 95.5/4.5 in twelve months. Any year-over-year per-share or attributable-profit comparison that ignores this is meaningless.

corporate_actions_2026.description: 8-K Item 7.01: announced a business and financial results update call for 2026-02-26.

8-K Item 1.01: Sales Agreement with UBS Securities LLC, B. Riley Securities, Canaccord Genuity and Tuohy Brothers for an ATM programme of up to $1,000,000,000 of Class A common stock. Prospectus supplement 424B5 filed the same day.
8-K Item 2.02: FY2025 and Q4 2025 results. 10-K for FY2025 filed the same day.

2026 Annual Meeting (virtual). Nine directors elected (Boeckmann, Chung, Fujino, Harshaw, Hopkins, Klein, Kresa, Walters, Warnica); say-on-pay approved 110,778,297 for / 4,203,069 against; Ernst & Young LLP ratified as auditor for FY2026. Results filed 8-K Item 5.07 on 2026-06-02.
DEF 14A for the 2026 annual meeting, including the beneficial ownership table as of 2026-03-30.

86,568,060 Class A shares issued in Q2 2026 alone for $947,214k net; $984,475k of net proceeds from common stock issuance in H1 2026. This is the $1.0B ATM being drawn down. Also 41,621 Class B units exchanged into Class A in the quarter.

8-K Item 1.01: a further Sales Agreement with UBS, B. Riley, Canaccord Genuity, Craig-Hallum, Texas Capital Securities (TCBI Securities) and Tuohy Brothers for an ATM programme of up to $750,000,000 of Class A common stock. Prospectus supplement 424B5 filed the same day.

No stock split, no reverse split, no bonus issue, no rights issue, no dividend, no buyback, no merger or scheme of arrangement. The only capital events are the two ATM programmes and routine Class B->Class A exchanges.

values.note: Carried from BATTERY/manifest.json; NOT re-verified in this collection.

analyst_consensus.note: Same rating and same analyst count, two different average targets ($11.97 vs $12.63) eight days apart. Not a defect on either side - an ordinary consensus-refresh lag, and exactly the kind of small divergence a differ must not flag as an app bug.

consolidated_vs_standalone.value: Not applicable in the Indian sense. NuScale files only US-GAAP CONSOLIDATED statements; there is no standalone/consolidated pair to choose between.
consolidated_vs_standalone.note: The FUNCTIONAL analogue - and the one that actually bites - is the Up-C attributable/total split: every income-statement bottom line and every equity line exists in two versions (excluding vs including noncontrolling interests). Code that models the Indian standalone/consolidated toggle and then ignores the attributable/total toggle for US names will silently show the wrong number by up to 5.5x (FY2022). See traps.two_bottom_lines.

traps.name: three_way_symbol_collision
traps.detail: 'SMR' resolves three ways at once: (a) NYSE:SMR = NuScale Power Corporation, CUSIP 67079K100, this entity; (b) BSE scrip 544774 = SMR Jewels Ltd, an unrelated Indian SME (group MT) present in the app's BSE master; (c) 'SMR' is the ordinary industry abbreviation for 'small modular reactor', which is NuScale's own product, so NuScale's own press coverage uses the token non-specifically. A resolver that picks by exchange master order, and a news/RAG pipeline that searches the bare token, fail differently and both fail silently.

traps.name: two_bottom_lines
traps.detail: Up-C structure. us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss (attributable to Class A) and us-gaap:ProfitLoss (total incl. NCI) are BOTH filed for every period and diverge enormously: FY2022 -$25.9M vs -$141.6M (5.5x), FY2023 -$58.4M vs -$180.1M (3.1x), FY2024 -$136.6M vs -$348.4M (2.5x), FY2025 -$355.8M vs -$664.5M (1.9x), TTM to 2026-06-30 -$415.7M vs -$672.9M. Every aggregator checked reports only the first. The ratio changes every year because the NCI share collapsed from 53.0% to 4.5% in twelve months, so the two series are not even a constant multiple of each other.

traps.name: spac_history_contamination
traps.detail: CIK 0001822966 was SPRING VALLEY ACQUISITION CORP. until 2022-04-29. Its SPAC-era XBRL sits in the SAME concept history: a NetIncomeLoss fact of -112,171 USD for FY2020 and a POSITIVE +3,202,748 USD for FY2021 coexist with NuScale's -88,387,000 and -102,493,000 for the same years. A pipeline that pulls a multi-year series from the CIK gets a company that was profitable in 2021, at 1/30th the scale, before becoming a reactor designer. Same hazard applies to any 'oldest filing' or 'listed since' inference.

traps.name: market_cap_depends_on_share_class_policy
traps.detail: Two reputable aggregators give $3.55B and $3.39B for the SAME $8.27 close on the SAME day, differing by exactly the 19,333,750 Class B shares. Class B has ONE VOTE AND NO ECONOMIC RIGHTS on its own, but each is paired 1:1 with an exchangeable NuScale LLC Class B unit that does carry economics - so both treatments are defensible and neither is a bug. A third figure ($4.59B, manifest) matches no filed share count at the current price.

traps.name: seventy_five_thousand_dollars_of_quarterly_revenue
traps.detail: Q2 FY2026 revenue is $75 THOUSAND (the statement is captioned 'in thousands' and the line reads '$ 75'). Q1 was $565 thousand. A parser that assumes the unit is millions renders $75,000,000 - a 1000x error on the single most quoted line, and precisely the class of small-cap misread the run brief calls out. Worse, gross margin is NEGATIVE (-$152k for the quarter) because a June 2026 price agreement with Fluor cut revenue and receivables by $175k, so revenue < cost of sales.

traps.name: negative_noncontrolling_interests
traps.detail: NCI on the balance sheet is -$47,652k, so total stockholders' equity ($2,013,657k) is LESS than equity attributable to Class A ($2,061,309k). Book-value and PB code that assumes NCI >= 0, or that adds NCI to reach total equity, produces a number roughly 7% off and a PB of 1.76 instead of the quoted 1.65.

traps.name: ttm_eps_does_not_equal_sum_of_quarters
traps.detail: Aggregator TTM EPS -$1.54; the four as-filed quarterly basic EPS figures sum to -$2.92. Cause: weighted-average Class A shares went 133,417,743 (Q2 FY2025) to 364,523,356 (Q2 FY2026) on ATM issuance, so per-share figures from different quarters are not additive. Neither number is wrong; an app that shows one and cites the other's source is.

traps.name: revenue_growth_has_four_right_answers
traps.detail: -99.07% (QoQ-year-ago), -97.01% (H1 vs H1), -81.0% (TTM), -15.02% (FY2025 vs FY2024). A bare 'Revenue growth' badge is uninterpretable for this name; the basis must be printed alongside it.

traps.name: no_split_despite_87_percent_drawdown
traps.detail: 52-week range $7.21-$57.42 against an $8.27 close, with NO split, reverse split or bonus in the window. Heuristics that infer a corporate action from an extreme price ratio (a common cleanup rule for Indian names) will wrongly 'adjust' this history. Corroborated by year-end market caps: $0.53B (2022), $0.25B (2023), $1.97B (2024), $4.20B (2025).

traps.name: near_identical_legal_entity_names
traps.detail: 'NuScale Power Corporation' (the NYSE registrant, Delaware) and 'NuScale Power, LLC' (its Oregon operating subsidiary) are distinct entities whose names differ by one word. The filings themselves use the shorthands 'NuScale Corp' and 'NuScale LLC' and attach different financial meanings to each (the LLC is where the Class B units and the NCI live). Entity resolution that normalises 'Corporation'/'LLC' away merges them.

traps.name: stale_ownership_by_construction
traps.detail: The only complete ownership table (DEF 14A) is dated 2026-03-30, against a Class A base of 323,734,120. By 2026-07-30 the base was 410,389,522 - 27% larger. Every percentage in that table is stale on the day it is published, and the staleness is caused by the company's own ATM, not by the data source. An app that prints proxy percentages next to a live price without the as-of date is reporting fiction.

traps.name: largest_holder_is_a_thematic_etf
traps.detail: Van Eck's 8.5% 13G position is 29,311,762 shares of which 19,974,830 belong economically to the VanEck Uranium and Nuclear ETF. The single largest reported institutional holder is passive thematic flow. Any 'smart money conviction' or 'institutional accumulation' signal derived from 13F/13G aggregates is reading an index rebalance.

traps.name: announcements_split_across_two_systems
traps.detail: The two most recent announcements (2026-09-01 MillenniTEK, 2026-08-25 nuclear-specific AI) exist ONLY on the company newsroom - no 8-K was filed for either. Conversely the ATM sales agreements exist only as 8-K/424B5 and got no press release. Neither source alone gives a complete announcement feed; an app wired to just one shows a plausible-looking but incomplete history.

traps.name: par_value_is_not_face_value
traps.detail: Par value is $0.0001 per share. Total par on 410.4M Class A shares is $41 thousand. Code that reuses the Indian 'face value' field for dividend-percent or ratio math will divide by a number seven orders of magnitude off.

traps.name: related_party_is_also_the_largest_holder_and_the_revenue
traps.detail: Fluor Enterprises, Inc. is simultaneously the largest Class A holder (12.68% at 2026-03-30), the contractor on the RoPower FEED Phase 2 work, and the counterparty whose June 2026 price agreement reduced NuScale's reported revenue by $175k. FY2025 revenue was explicitly flagged as largely related-party ($7,431k of Q2 FY2025's $8,054k). Revenue-quality screens that ignore the related-party caption overstate the independence of nearly all historical revenue.

world_gaps.detail: ROCE is not published for US filers by SEC or by the aggregators checked, and NuScale does not disclose it. Published proxies: ROIC -11.18%, ROA -10.60%. An app showing a ROCE figure for SMR has computed it itself and must say so.

There is no SEBI-style quarterly shareholding pattern for a US issuer, and no US concept of a 'promoter' or of promoter share pledging. The nearest filed substitutes are captured above: the annual DEF 14A beneficial-ownership table (>5% holders, insiders, one date a year) and event-driven SCHEDULE 13G/13D filings. Any promoter/pledge value rendered for this symbol is fabricated or mis-joined from the BSE SMR Jewels record.

The business combination closing date 2022-05-02 is sourced (TRA execution date in the 10-Q). The exact first day Class A traded on the NYSE under SMR was not confirmed from a primary source in this collection. Recorded as unverified rather than asserted.
CUSIP 67079K100 is sourced twice over. ISIN US67079K1007 is computed from it (US + CUSIP + Luhn check digit). Not independently confirmed against a securities master.

Carried from BATTERY/manifest.json and NOT re-verified: the session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was exhausted at the first call and tipranks was not fetched directly. Treated as second-hand throughout.

world_gaps.field: price conflict recorded in the manifest ($8.45 vs $10.21 for mid-September 2026)
world_gaps.detail: Two independent sources agree the 2026-09-18 close was $8.27. Neither manifest figure matches. $8.45 is plausibly an intraday or prior-session print; $10.21 is far outside the recent range and is more likely a stale or mis-scoped quote. The original conflict is retained in the manifest and is itself a useful diff target; this pack does not claim to have resolved which source produced which.
Derived from the full EDGAR filing index for CIK 0001822966 plus the company newsroom. Form 4/144 insider transactions (numerous) are deliberately excluded as routine and not corporate actions.
